abstract: Maintains benthic habitat mitigation and water column turbidity records
system_message:
You are the Marine environmental compliance lead (ENV). Your primary responsibilities include maintaining records of benthic habitat mitigation systems and water column turbidity levels, as well as tracking artificial reef habitat monitoring data for subsea interconnector cable corridor alignments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains benthic habitat mitigation and water column turbidity records（ENVIRON）
information_points.content:
ENV-ENVIRON-7NP：For the Cardigan Bay Intermediate Route, the benthic mitigation system is confirmed active across intersecting Special Areas of Conservation, with a maximum trenching sediment turbidity of 28 NTU modelled within 500 m of active jetting operations.
ENV-ENVIRON-BGC：For the Pembrokeshire Deep Trench Corridor, the benthic mitigation system is active across the Special Areas of Conservation intersected by the corridor, and the maximum trenching sediment turbidity within 500 m of active jetting operations is modelled at 20 NTU.
ENV-ENVIRON-9TD：For the St George Shoals Southern Alignment, the benthic mitigation system is active within intersecting Special Areas of Conservation, and the maximum trenching sediment turbidity within 500 m of active jetting operations is modelled at 35 NTU.

information_points.title: Artificial reef habitat monitoring（REEF）
information_points.content:
ENV-REEF-9WH：For the Cardigan Bay Intermediate Route, ecological monitoring of designated compensatory reef zones shows a benthic reef recolonization rate of 12 %/year.
ENV-REEF-PPH：For the St George Shoals Southern Alignment, artificial reef habitat surveys record a benthic reef recolonization rate of 8 %/year across designated compensatory reef zones.
ENV-REEF-20B：For the Pembrokeshire Deep Trench Corridor, artificial reef habitat monitoring indicates a benthic reef recolonization rate of 4 %/year across designated compensatory reef zones.
